items.name: The Hush
items.description: Halloran-Vey Sanitation Agent, Pattern H, logged as Asset Seven: a matte ceramic egg in a cryo-sleeve that kills every human in a habitat and spares the machines. Fail-deadly: warmed past forty kelvin or breached, it vents. Cannot be destroyed, only kept cold.

items.name: The Share Plate
items.description: A steel plate cut from the Patience's hull, carrying the names of the three hundred bonded who took the ship. Later the founding relic of the city of Patience; its back hides an engraving under hull sealant.

items.name: Maren's hook-knife
items.description: A tether-chief's hook-bladed line knife, worn in a sheath on the coat. The tool of every cut in the book.

items.name: Tether-chief's coat
items.description: Heavy quilted pressure-coat of the Patience's tether-chief, TSOLO stencilled across the back.

items.name: Lusine's clip
items.description: The harness clip that failed on Lusine Arda's line, cut part-way through with a blade.

items.name: Quist's key
items.description: The factor's authorisation key, the only deliberate way to release the Sanitation Agent.

items.name: Abel's recorder
items.description: A rigger's voice-log, left on the Lamp with what Abel Tsolo had to say to whoever came.

items.name: Isaura's gauge
items.description: An air-warden's flow gauge and valve key: the instrument of the air-tithe.

items.name: Isaura's recorder
items.description: The voice-log Isaura Venn leaves on the Lamp in 2654.

items.name: The Vey register
items.description: Hollis Vey's family archive: Halloran-Vey loss registers and memoranda, five centuries old.

items.name: Juno's bond
items.description: The paper by which Mother Szabo owns Juno Brask's labour against her dead mother's debt.
